# 易緯乾元序制記

**ID:** KR1a0168
**Custom ID:** ZB1a0165
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V53.9, p899
**Extent:** 1 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 鄭玄 (漢朝) 註

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The sixth of the eight *Yì wěi* 易緯 texts gathered as appendix to the *Yì*-class of the *Sìkù quánshū*; see [KR1a0163](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0163) for the broader contextualization. One juàn. The work treats the cosmographic-cosmological sequencing-and-setting (*xù zhì* 序制) of phenomena ordered from the source-of-*Qián* (*Qián yuán* 乾元), drawing on the *Yìjīng*'s opening hexagram as the source-point of cosmological generation.

**Abstract**

The work is a compact one-juàn member of the *Yì wěi* corpus, focusing on cosmological-cosmographic sequencing through the *Qián* hexagram. The Zhèng Xuán-commentary attribution is conventional and not secure.
